general.title: OMIX GSVA
general.instructions: Calculate sample-level pathway enrichment scores from normalized continuous expression. Provide one upstream bundle containing the expression matrix and matching sample metadata. The default MSigDB compatibility database is attached internally; select a different Pathway Database File only when intentionally using another approved long-format membership table. Raw counts are not supported.

datasets.name: Expression and sample metadata
datasets.description: Provide one attached data asset containing a normalized gene-by-sample expression table and its matching sample metadata table. In workflows, replace this input with an upstream OMIX result bundle that supplies both files. OMIX Limma Analysis can supply Batch_Corrected_Expression.csv together with Sample_Metadata.csv.

parameters.name: Normalized Expression File
